relationships.subject: Lactate
relationships.evidence_quote: Lactate is a potent activator of ASICs, which have high expression in a variety of peripheral sensory neurons, including proprioceptors

relationships.subject: Substance P
relationships.evidence_quote: ASIC1a-mediated anti-nociception also depends on the release of substance P from muscle afferents.

key_findings: Review proposing that acid-sensing proprioceptors (ASIC3-expressing) contribute to chronic musculoskeletal pain via glutamate and lactate signalling in muscle spindles.
